summary.name: AI Compare Ninja
summary.one_liner: A free editorial search and comparison site for AI tools, showing sourced prices, usage limits and free access, plus prompts, skills, agents and an LLM API cost calculator.
use_cases: Comparing prices and usage limits of AI tools before subscribing
Estimating LLM API costs for a project
Finding free AI tools for a specific task
Finding ready-made prompts and skills for business or personal work
Browsing AI tools by category such as video, design or coding
summary.what_it_does:
The site catalogs 973 AI tools and lists their prices, limits and free access, with sources and check dates according to the page. It offers 176 fill-in prompts, 137 skills provided as SKILL.md files, 126 ready-made agents and 59 loops. A cost calculator estimates subscription and API costs without sign-up. Tools are grouped by category, with side-by-side comparisons of two tools. The page states that results are not a quality ranking and are ordered by task match or alphabetically.</what_it_does>

notable: Prices and limits listed with official vendor sources and check dates; missing facts are left unpublished
Explicitly not a ranking; ordering is by task match or alphabetical, with advertising labelled
Prompts, skills and agents usable without an account
LLM API cost calculator requiring no sign-up
caveats: Paid express review speeds up review of a submitted tool but does not change its position, per the page
Prices can vary by region, login and promotion; the vendor page is authoritative
Listing is not guaranteed; tools must meet the site's relevance, working and legality criteria
